```{=html}
<div id="sheet-meta" data-sheet="06" data-title="Play" data-top="4600" data-bottom="5000" hidden></div>
<span class="label">Sheet 06 · 4,600 to 5,000 ft</span>
<p class="lede muted" style="font-size:1.1rem;max-width:700px;margin-top:0.75rem">Drill today's well. Steer down through the rock, land in the window at 4,000 ft, then turn sideways and stay inside the pay zone. Everyone gets the same well each day.</p>

<div class="legend">
  <span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7" class="lg-o"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.5" class="lg-o thin"/></svg> Approved part: take it</span>
  <span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7" class="lg-o dash"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2.5" class="lg-o thin"/></svg> Counterfeit (dashed): skip it</span>
  <span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" class="lg-f"/><path d="M14 6 L9 13 H15 L10 19" class="lg-w"/></svg> Expedited shipment</span>
  <span><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8" class="lg-i"/><path d="M1 12 H23 M12 1 V23" class="lg-i"/></svg> Survey: shows hidden boulders</span>
</div>
<div class="keys">
  <span><kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>→</kbd> <span class="muted">hold to steer right, let go to drift left</span></span>
  <span class="muted">In the lateral: hold to climb, let go to sink</span>
  <span class="muted">On a phone: touch and hold</span>
</div>

<div class="game-wrap" id="game">
  <canvas id="game-canvas" width="720" height="480" aria-label="Drilling game"></canvas>
  <div class="game-overlay" id="game-start">
    <div class="inner">
      <span class="label label-orange">Spud in</span>
      <h2>Steer the bit</h2>
      <p class="muted">Soft rock drills fast, hard rock drills slow. Parts keep you drilling. Run out and you wait on a supplier. Take a counterfeit and the tool fails a moment later.</p>
      <button class="bp-btn" id="game-go">Start drilling</button>
      <p class="mono" id="best-line" style="margin:0.8rem 0 0"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="game-overlay" id="game-end" hidden>
    <div class="inner">
      <span class="label label-orange" id="end-tag">Total depth · 5,000 ft</span>
      <div class="end-score" id="end-score">0</div>
      <div class="game-stats">
        <div>Time</div><div id="st-time">0.0 s</div>
        <div>In the pay zone</div><div id="st-zone">0%</div>
        <div>Parts</div><div id="st-parts">0</div>
        <div>Counterfeits</div><div id="st-bad">None</div>
        <div>Supplier waits</div><div id="st-waits">0</div>
        <div>Landing</div><div id="st-land">In the window</div>
        <div>Your best</div><div id="st-best">0</div>
      </div>
      <p id="end-line"></p>
      <p class="muted">Every tool down here needed someone to get the right parts in on time. That's the part I do.</p>
      <div class="btn-row" style="justify-content:center">
        <button class="bp-btn" id="game-again">Drill again</button>
        <a class="bp-btn-ghost" href="projects/index.html">See my work</a>
        <a class="bp-btn-ghost" href="index.html#contact">Say hello</a>
        <button class="bp-btn-ghost" id="game-share" type="button">Copy score</button>
      </div>
      <p style="margin:0"><a href="drill-log.html" class="mono">You unlocked the drill log →</a></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script src="assets/js/game.js"></script>
```
